title: Critical-window emergence of autocatalytic sets under reaction-channel quotienting
abstract: Hordijk and Steel (https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.03919, Section 7, Eq. (21)) conjectured a zero-one threshold for RAF emergence at linear mean catalysis. An interior limiting law is established for the reversible binary-polymer model with monomer/dimer food and reaction channels obtained by identifying the split descriptions u + v and v + u precisely when uv = vu. Each molecule independently catalyzes each channel, with one catalysis coordinate shared by both directions. For every real sequence f(n)/n → λ > 0, the clamped channel parameter eventually equals f(n)/|J_n|, and the probability of a reflexively autocatalytic and food-generated (RAF) set converges to a limit L(λ) depending only on λ. The function L is nondecreasing and satisfies 0 < L(λ) ≤ 1 − exp(−34λ) < 1 at every positive finite intensity. Thus a zero-one step threshold is excluded in this channel model.
